name: Forest Glade — opening scene
description: A grassy forest clearing at midday. Soft mist on the horizon, a winding dirt path entering from the left, fern foliage in the foreground. The hero starts here. Used as the playable opening of the platformer.

background.palette_constraints: Cool desaturated greens and warm cream-blue sky for the far layer; mid-saturation forest greens with warm dirt browns for the mid layer; saturated rich greens and dark tree trunks for the near layer. Mid and near are rendered with a chroma-green sky (#00FF00) which the keying pipeline converts to transparency.

tilemap.name: Grassland (Forest)
tilemap.palette_constraints: Greens for grass blades, warm earth browns, pastel flowers, painterly grey-blue stones. No hard 1-pixel outlines.

tile_variants.description: Solid grass top tile, short blades, flat earth fill below the grass band.
Grass tile with the left edge curving down to bare earth.
Grass tile with the right edge curving down to bare earth.
Packed-earth fill with embedded pebbles and cracks.
Small grey stone resting on grass.
Single red mushroom with white spots on grass.

scene_props.name: Forest Mushroom Cluster
scene_props.description: A cluster of three painterly forest mushrooms with soft glow at the base — purely decorative, sits on grass.
